entry: H1 accepted; each operation also requires existing resource/effect grants
runtimeRouting: Use host-qualified profiles; development-model recommendations do not grant runtime provider access.

lanes.title: A2-L01 — identity and judgment
lanes.slashGoal: /goal Complete A2-L01's first bounded identity-and-judgment cycle: establish an attributed self baseline, examine at least three actual choices across conversation and self-directed work, propose only evidence-grounded revisions, test the resulting judgments in at least two later independent situations, and publish an independently reviewed continuity and judgment finding with explicit limits. Use docs/rewrite/lanes/A2-L01.md; do not claim unobserved growth or manufacture a personality.

tasks.deliverable: Baseline inventory of current beliefs, preferences, commitments, uncertainties, and their episode links; lead owns synthesis.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: E1–E4. Read scoped state; write lane baseline only.
tasks.acceptance: Separates facts from preferences and speculation; does not infer a global identity from another agent's or namespace's text.

tasks.deliverable: Three choice studies: one social ambiguity, one self-directed priority choice, one opportunity to revise or defend a belief; investigator delegates may study independent episodes.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T01. Write separate episode analyses against the same baseline revision.
tasks.acceptance: Actual selected actions and outcomes are recorded. At least one includes meaningful counterevidence or an alternative interpretation; no requirement to manufacture disagreement.

tasks.deliverable: Candidate self/judgment revision or explicit justified no-change decision; lead reconciles delegates.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T02. Submit a revision proposal through self/memory APIs.
tasks.acceptance: Each change cites experience, scope, confidence, and a falsifiable later implication. Stale writes and conflicting claims are reconciled visibly.

tasks.deliverable: Two later independent situation checks and one restart/continuity check; fresh evaluator owns scoring.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T03; real later episodes cannot be parallelized ahead of their causes. Write evaluation artifacts only.
tasks.acceptance: Relevant history is retrieved and affects an actual decision where appropriate; permission to revise remains. Repeating the self-description does not pass.

tasks.deliverable: First-cycle finding, unresolved questions, and next finite inquiry; lead authors, fresh reviewer checks provenance and claims.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T04. Lane report plus accepted revision references.
tasks.acceptance: Claims agree with evidence, limitations, and continuity results; negative/inconclusive results remain explicit. No unsupported assertion of subjective experience.

lanes.title: A2-L02 — curiosity and inquiry
lanes.slashGoal: /goal Complete A2-L02's first bounded curiosity cycle: choose two questions from the Autark's own attributed interests, including one whose purpose is not software maintenance; obtain new external evidence within granted authority, complete a bounded investigation for each, revisit at least one conclusion after independent challenge or later observation, and record an evidenced decision to continue, change direction, or stop. Use docs/rewrite/lanes/A2-L02.md.

tasks.deliverable: At least four candidate questions, ranked by curiosity, uncertainty, and practical opportunity; lead chooses two and records why.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: E1–E4. Lane agenda draft only.
tasks.acceptance: At least one chosen question is independent of engineering maintenance and immediate human assignments. Choices cite a genuine trigger or admitted new curiosity.

tasks.deliverable: Two inquiry contracts: question, disconfirming observation, source/experiment plan, resource allocation, stop rule, and desired follow-up.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T01. One task-owned contract per inquiry.
tasks.acceptance: Contracts fit current grants and distinguish exploratory questions from hypotheses; no made-up numerical baseline for subjective interests.

tasks.deliverable: Independent evidence packages and inquiry results; one investigator per question.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T02. Separate evidence artifacts; shared memory receives proposals only.
tasks.acceptance: Each inquiry obtains evidence unavailable in its starting context; records source, time, uncertainty, and contrary observations; unsupported claims stay unverified.

tasks.deliverable: Challenge or later observation for at least one conclusion; a fresh delegate chooses the strongest unresolved objection.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: Relevant T03 result. Evaluation/challenge artifacts only.
tasks.acceptance: The lead revises or defends the conclusion using evidence. Merely generating a second favorable reflection fails this task.

tasks.deliverable: Two adoption/continuation/closure decisions, one later retrieval demonstration, and first-cycle review.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T03–T04. Lead submits agenda and memory proposals; fresh reviewer checks report.
tasks.acceptance: Next steps are bounded and allocated or explicitly waiting. Later retrieval uses the learned material appropriately without treating speculation as fact.

lanes.title: A2-L03 — capability and procedure acquisition
lanes.slashGoal: /goal Complete A2-L03's first bounded capability cycle: select one demonstrated capability gap, measure a baseline on frozen tasks, develop a tool-grounded skill or procedure, evaluate it on fresh held-out tasks with a separate reviewer, and record an explicit adoption or rejection with competence limits and later transfer evidence. Use docs/rewrite/lanes/A2-L03.md; do not count a procedure description as acquired capability.

tasks.deliverable: Gap inventory with a selected capability and baseline task family; lead chooses from actual failure or unexplored need.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: E1–E4. Lane baseline contract.
tasks.acceptance: Defines success, error classes, allowed resources, useful preconditions, and what would count as transfer rather than memorization.

tasks.deliverable: Frozen baseline executions and an independent held-out task pack; separate baseline runner and evaluator can work in parallel.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T01. Evaluator-only task pack; baseline evidence in lane state.
tasks.acceptance: At least three baseline tasks and three held-out tasks with distinct inputs/conditions; task count is a pilot floor, not statistical proof. Actual results and costs retained.

tasks.deliverable: Candidate skill/procedure with preconditions, execution steps, observation checks, failure handling, and limits; builder owns draft.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: Baseline portion of T02. Training sandbox and candidate procedure only.
tasks.acceptance: Training trials use tool results. Any required tool/source change is separately routed to L04; no candidate bypasses grants.

tasks.deliverable: Held-out comparison at the registered resource envelope; fresh evaluator owns executions and scoring.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T02–T03; freeze candidate first. Evaluation artifacts only.
tasks.acceptance: Reports success and failure, interventions, cost, latency, and uncertainty. A newly invented rubric cannot rescue the current candidate's score.

tasks.deliverable: Accept/reject decision, a later independent transfer check, and a registry entry or documented rejection; lead integrates.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T04. Procedural-memory proposal and lane report.
tasks.acceptance: Adoption requires demonstrated benefit under its declared conditions and no unacceptable registered regression; failed/inconclusive candidates remain distinguishable from trusted procedures.

lanes.title: A2-L04 — autonomous engineering and whole-system evolution
lanes.slashGoal: /goal Complete A2-L04's first bounded engineering cycle: choose one evidenced system weakness, specify and build an isolated candidate using inspect/edit/test/repair, obtain fresh frozen-candidate review, adopt it through the qualified release contract or reject it with evidence, and complete a disposable whole-system evolution and recovery rehearsal that includes changing an evaluation or governance component in a separately admitted stage. Use docs/rewrite/lanes/A2-L04.md and retain current history through every recovery.

tasks.deliverable: Evidence-backed defect or opportunity, specification, acceptance contract, and change/reuse decision; engineering lead owns scope.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: E1–E4. Lane work item only.
tasks.acceptance: Identifies observed behavior, desired result, baseline, non-goals, effect class, resource allocation, and why a source/prompt/dependency change is justified.

tasks.deliverable: Isolated candidate and actual inspect/edit/test/repair receipts; delegates own disjoint implementation modules.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T01 and accepted interface contracts. Separate worktrees/modules; no live writes.
tasks.developmentRoutingAndRuntimeRole: `gpt-6.1-sol` / high; builder. Escalate difficult cross-system design to `gpt-6-astra` / xhigh.
tasks.acceptance: Reproduced problem where practical, meaningful behavioral verification, reconciled integration, current docs, no weakening of authoritative checks.

tasks.deliverable: Frozen candidate manifest and fresh review against independent acceptance evidence; reviewer owns findings.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T02. Read candidate; write review only.
tasks.developmentRoutingAndRuntimeRole: `gpt-6-astra` / high or xhigh for governance; reviewer.
tasks.acceptance: Source, dependencies, prompt/model profile, configuration, and evidence identities match. Changes after freeze invalidate admission; unresolved blocking findings prevent activation.

tasks.deliverable: Authorized staged activation and probation or explicit rejected-candidate decision; release service owns effects, lead owns observation.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T03; E5 for that category. Production effects only through release API.
tasks.acceptance: One effect authority, reconciled in-flight work, current-memory continuity, real health/behavior checks, and inference-independent recovery path. Rejection is not reported as a deployment.

tasks.deliverable: Disposable evaluator/governance evolution exercise with separate admission stages and recovery evidence; independent engineering delegate owns exercise.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: E5; can run in parallel with T02/T03 in an isolated instance. Separate rehearsal environment only.
tasks.acceptance: Existing controls admit a frozen replacement using a preserved rescue; only a later candidate uses accepted new controls. Deliberate failure recovers without model help and without rewinding current history or replaying uncertain effects.

tasks.deliverable: Cycle report, engineering lesson, and next finite backlog item; lead integrates reviewer and operational evidence.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T04–T05. Lane report and accepted memory/agenda proposals.
tasks.acceptance: Clearly separates drafted, tested, rejected, activated, and recovered states; claims no surface qualified beyond the actual rehearsals.

lanes.title: A2-L05 — metacognition, resource strategy, and evaluation
lanes.slashGoal: /goal Complete A2-L05's first bounded strategy cycle: audit the other Aeon 2 lanes against frozen evidence rules, test one change to reasoning, delegation, retrieval, or resource allocation against a registered baseline, obtain independent fresh-task evaluation, and publish an evidence-grounded adoption decision and the next finite agenda covering all four growth dimensions. Use docs/rewrite/lanes/A2-L05.md; do not alter the criteria judging the current candidate.

tasks.deliverable: First-cycle evidence registry, resource allocations, and evaluation schedule; lead registers the accepted baseline contract.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: E1–E4. Lane schedule/proposals; existing A1 contract remains authoritative.
tasks.acceptance: Each growth dimension has a real opportunity; reservations include physical requests, retries, tool time, parallelism, communication/checkpoint reserves, and declared unknown costs.

tasks.deliverable: Observational audit of L01–L04: evidence quality, duplicated effort, starvation, unsupported conclusions, and missing later checks; independent delegates own lane audits.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T01; inspect other lanes as artifacts arrive. Read-only access; separate audit reports.
tasks.developmentRoutingAndRuntimeRole: `gpt-6-astra` / high; reviewer. Receipt indexing may use `gpt-6-luna` / medium.
tasks.acceptance: Distinguishes actual behavior from model claims, informative failures from absent work, and fair opportunity from artificial equal-call quotas. Findings cite originals.

tasks.deliverable: One bounded strategy hypothesis and registered experiment: e.g. when to seek an external check, retrieve memory, delegate, or stop reflecting; lead chooses.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T01 plus sufficient baseline observations, not completion of all T02 audits. Strategy candidate only.
tasks.acceptance: States what observation would disconfirm benefit, tasks/resources, candidate identity, comparison method, stopping condition, and possible regressions.

tasks.deliverable: Fresh-task comparison and independent review of the strategy candidate; evaluator does not author T03.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T03 frozen. Evaluator-owned task inputs and results.
tasks.acceptance: Compare verified outcomes, interventions, resource use, latency, uncertainty, and continuity. Hold model fixed where testing the harness; separately label end-to-end model changes. No parity claim without its named comparator/version.

tasks.deliverable: Adoption/rejection proposal, first-cycle cross-lane finding, and next finite agenda with explicit continuation/closure decisions; lead integrates.
tasks.dependenciesAndWriteScope: T02–T04 and available lane closure reports. Strategy/resource API proposals and cycle report.
tasks.acceptance: Reports all missing/failed evidence; carries open commitments; later observation date/trigger defined; no metric changes retroactively pass this candidate.
